breaking_news.headline: Trump strips job protections from 8,000 federal workers
breaking_news.summary: President Trump signed an executive order that puts some 8,000 high-ranking civil servants into a new category of employees who can be fired for any reason.

breaking_news.headline: A former GEO Group executive now runs ICE. The company's government ties run deep
breaking_news.summary: David Venturella's appointment as acting ICE director is the latest in a pattern: Many former employees of the private prison company GEO Group end up working at the federal agency, and vice versa.

breaking_news.headline: As Strait of Hormuz stays shut, companies seek new routes for trade
breaking_news.summary: Shipping companies are looking for alternative routes as the Strait of Hormuz lockdown drags on.

breaking_news.headline: How cellphone carriers prepare for hurricane season with AI, drones and 'cows'
breaking_news.summary: Hurricane season is expected to be milder than usual this year. But that's not stopping cell phone companies from pulling out all the stops.

breaking_news.headline: What do you actually get when you pay for AI?
breaking_news.summary: Just 3% of U.S. households pay for AI for personal use. Sign ups are growing — even though Americans have subscription fatigue.

breaking_news.headline: A global World Cup tradition catches fire in the U.S.: Panini sticker collecting
breaking_news.summary: Collecting Panini stickers is a World Cup tradition beloved in Europe and Latin America. In the U.S., interest has been building steadily, and this summer, the buzz is bigger than ever.

breaking_news.headline: The U.S. adds 172,000 jobs. Many are in restaurants, bars and hotels
breaking_news.summary: U.S. employers added jobs for the third month in a row in May, while the unemployment rate held steady at 4.3%. But wage gains softened and likely failed to keep pace with rising prices.

breaking_news.headline: In the wake of layoffs, some tech workers are exploring new careers
breaking_news.summary: Amid widespread tech layoffs, some highly skilled workers are making radical career changes. Some laid-off workers are turning to lower paying temp jobs, and some are leaving tech altogether.

breaking_news.headline: Malawians repatriated from South Africa amid xenophobia concerns
breaking_news.summary: Malawi is among several African nations transporting their citizens out of the country following reports of violence against migrants.

breaking_news.headline: 'A World Cup for them not us': Fans' anger at US travel bans and visa restrictions
breaking_news.summary: Fans across the world say US travel bans and visa regulations make them feel excluded from the World Cup.

breaking_news.headline: Trump abruptly ends NBC interview after clash over 'rigged election' claim
breaking_news.summary: During the interview, the president was repeatedly challenged on several points by the show's presenter Kristen Welker.

breaking_news.headline: Zelensky's close European allies set out five conditions for peace talks
breaking_news.summary: The Ukrainian president's meeting with his staunchest European allies came as US President Donald Trump's focus shifts to the war with Iran.

breaking_news.headline: Knicks' long-awaited NBA run electrifies NYC, with Trump set to attend key game
breaking_news.summary: The Knicks' stunning winning streak has energised the city as the New York basketball team prepares for the third game of the finals series at its home arena.

breaking_news.headline: Armenia's pro-West government wins election despite Russian pressure
breaking_news.summary: Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan's Civil Contract Party secures nearly 50% of the vote, comfortably beating the other contenders.

breaking_news.headline: Rare footage captured of Great White shark in Mediterranean Sea
breaking_news.summary: A volunteer diver has described shaking as he filmed his encounter with an endangered Great White shark between Tunisia and Sicily.

breaking_news.headline: At least 32 dead after major earthquake strikes southern Philippines
breaking_news.summary: The magnitude-7.8 quake triggered small tsunami waves in the Philippines, Indonesia and Japan.

breaking_news.headline: I was applying for hundreds of jobs - this tip helped me get one
breaking_news.summary: Four people who weren't hearing back from job applications shared what they did differently to secure their first role.

breaking_news.headline: City Airport faces opposition to large jet plans
breaking_news.summary: A committee of the London Assembly wants London City Airport's plans halted due to noise concerns.

breaking_news.headline: Spain's visitor numbers hit new highs as tourists avoid Middle East
breaking_news.summary: The European country had 9.1 million international visitors in April, the most ever for that month.

breaking_news.headline: 'No dead ends': What the Dutch can teach us about tackling youth unemployment
breaking_news.summary: The Netherlands has one of the world's lowest rates of 16 to 24-year-olds not in education, employment or training.
